subject: RESUME statement
notes: Rule: 'Procedure-name-1 shall be a procedure-name in the nondeclarative portion of the function, method, or program.' (cite.py --check 14.9.33.3 -> OK §14.9.33.3 3)). BindResume resolves procedure-name-1 through the ONE procedure-operand resolution (scoped to the source element, so a name of another program does not resolve) and refuses a target whose SECTION is declarative (target.IsDeclarative, PB433) with COBOL0714. PROBED with the pinned cobol.exe: RESUME AT a declarative paragraph (sr3_D2.cob) and RESUME AT the declarative section itself (sr3_D.cob) -> COBOL0714; RESUME AT an undeclared name (sr3_X9.cob) -> COBOL1639; RESUME AT a nondeclarative paragraph compiles and transfers (gr3b.cob). pb1010_method_declaratives exercises the method arm. No test asserts COBOL0714 (searched tests/ for 0714: none), so the row is CONFORMS-but-untested; the needed negative is a declarative RESUME AT one of its own paragraphs.
